body.statement: distance.distance_ilp, one integer program solved by SCIP, computes d_Z exactly: it equals an exhaustive enumeration on 200 random codes at 8 small sizes (n <= 50), equals d_X on the same codes, gives min(l, m) on the toric code at 14 sizes up to n = 576 and d = 16 that development did not run, and agrees, within its bounds where it stops at its limit, with an LP-free exhaustive search (distance_search, from every qubit and from (0, lm)) on 9 trinomial codes of the published form at n = 162 to 216. Applied to the 12 entries of ../qec-bb/codes.json, the program and the search from (0, lm), each with a 90-minute limit, give the published distance d: each entry is reproduced, consistent but unresolved, contradicted, or a method error, by the registered rule.
